# Absence Is Not Omission

Three files, nothing to arrange. Set the root document to `main.tex`
and compile with pdfLaTeX, which is Overleaf's default.

The figures are TikZ and the tables are LaTeX, both written from the
analysis output rather than typed, so edit them in the analysis
repository. Anything changed here is lost the next time the bundle is
rebuilt.

Nine content pages, which is the long-track limit. References and the
checklist do not count against it.

On acceptance, change the style option to `[dblblindworkshop, final]`
and add the author block. That is what puts the workshop name in the
page-one footer; until then the footer correctly reads "Submitted
to ... Do not distribute."
